observed_evidence: After nearly a century of excavation, no building is securely identified as a royal palace.
limits: Absence of a securely identified palace does not prove that rulers or elite residences did not exist.

observed_evidence: Indus cemeteries have not yielded the elaborate ruler tombs familiar from several contemporary early states.
limits: Uneven excavation and preservation make this an archaeological observation, not proof of social equality.

observed_evidence: Large buildings existed, but none is securely identified as a monumental temple controlled by a ruling class.
limits: Building function remains debated; unknown function is not evidence of secular government.

observed_evidence: No securely identified monumental program centers a named ruler in the manner of many contemporary royal states.
limits: The undeciphered script prevents direct comparison with royal titulature elsewhere.
